alert.title: Wimborne / Ferndown hub declared down
alert.body: European Critical Care demand moves to the German FSL; Osmolality, QC and Bioprocess customers fall back to the US by international air. 3 customers outside SLA.

recommendation.title: Pre-position Osmolality and Bioprocess stock in Germany
recommendation.body: The German FSL already covers Critical Care for six countries. Adding OSM and BIO stock there would keep European customers within SLA during a UK hub outage instead of air-freighting from Massachusetts.

sections.title: Key insight
sections.body: A Billerica outage moves Critical Care and Bioprocess demand to the UK hub by international air: 25 customers fall outside SLA and freight rises 291%. Pre-positioning contingency stock at Norwood returns the network to 97.9% at near-normal cost. This is the quantified case for a contingency stocking policy, and it ties directly to the Continuity Command Center.

controlTower.panelSubtitle: Switch a scenario above · every KPI is compared with normal operations

steps.title: Normal operations
steps.body:
Billerica – Enterprise Rd ships Critical Care and Bioprocess to most North American customers.

Customers within SLA: 97.9% (46/47)
Avg transit: 1.2 days
Weekly freight: $33,665
Weekly CO₂e: 4,265 kg

Sample data: Nova sites from the ERP/CRM footprint (locations approximate); customers, suppliers, volumes and rates are illustrative.

steps.title: Billerica DC goes offline
steps.body:
The engine re-plans instantly: Critical Care and Bioprocess demand falls back to the UK hub by international air. 25 customers fall outside SLA.

Customers within SLA: 46.8% (22/47)
Avg transit: 2.8 days
Weekly freight: $131,526 (+291% vs normal)
Weekly CO₂e: 16,475 kg (+286% vs normal)

steps.title: The impact lands on hospitals
steps.body: Hospital Critical Care customers have a 2-day SLA; a transatlantic air lane with customs takes 3. Every red ring is a hospital that would wait longer for analyzers and consumables.

steps.title: Activate Norwood as the contingency DC
steps.body:
Pre-positioning Critical Care and Bioprocess stock at Norwood restores service at near-normal cost.

Customers within SLA: 97.9% (46/47)
Avg transit: 1.2 days
Weekly freight: $33,857 (+1% vs normal)
Weekly CO₂e: 4,266 kg (+0% vs normal)

This is the quantified case for a contingency stocking policy, the same plan the Continuity Command Center would execute.

steps.title: Recovered network
steps.body: Same customers, same SLAs: served from Norwood while Billerica is down.

items.question: Which customers miss SLA if Billerica is down?
items.answer:
25 customers fall outside SLA if Billerica – Enterprise Rd goes offline, 22 of them hospitals on a 2-day Critical Care SLA. Demand falls back to Wimborne by international air (3 days including customs).

Biggest by volume: New York (17/wk), Boston (15/wk), Chicago (14/wk), Los Angeles (13/wk).

Weekly freight rises from $33,665 to $131,526 (+291%). Activating Norwood as a contingency DC brings it back to 97.9% within SLA at $33,857.

items.question: Why isn't Boston served from Norwood?
items.answer: Norwood is Boston's nearest node (34 km) but its stocking profile carries Osmolality only. Boston buys Critical Care, which is stocked at Billerica – Enterprise Rd (normal operations) and, under the contingency profile, at Norwood too.

items.question: Cheapest way to serve Seoul within 3 days?
items.answer: There is none today. The Japan FSL serves Japan only, so Seoul ships from Wimborne by international air in 4 days against a 3-day SLA. A Korea stocking point, or letting Taipei manufacturing hold finished Critical Care stock, would close the gap at roughly a third of the current lane cost.

items.question: Show me every single-source lane via Suez
items.answer: Three single-source lanes share the Suez route: sensor chips (Hsinchu → Waltham, 36 d), lithium cells (Suzhou → Billerica Lexington Rd, 35 d) and PCB assemblies (Penang → Billerica Manning Rd, 39 d). Motors from Shenzhen use it too but have a second source. A 7-day canal closure delays all four at once.
